name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: .NET Developer | .NET Core & Framework | RESTful API Design | Microservices | SQL Optimization | CI/CD Automation
summary: .NET Developer with 10+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems using .NET Framework and .NET Core across finance and retail domains. Proven track record of developing high-throughput microservices, optimizing RESTful APIs, and streamlining CI/CD pipelines to deliver reliable, maintainable backend solutions in remote cross-functional teams.

bullets: Designed and developed 10+ scalable microservices using .NET Framework and .NET Core, supporting inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs with ASP.NET Web API, reducing average response time by 25–35% through improved error handling, caching, and versioning strategies.
Partnered with product and planning teams to deliver backend .NET solutions that improved forecast accuracy and reduced stock discrepancies across global retail operations.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for .NET services, decreasing deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases.
Enforced code quality practices (SonarQube, unit testing) across .NET codebases, reducing production defects by 30% and improving maintainability.
Standardized CI/CD workflows across .NET microservices, increasing deployment success rate to >95%.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting a global retail client, enabling scalable inventory processing and decision-making.
Developed .NET microservices for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations.
Implemented asynchronous processing and integrations (JBoss Fuse), improving system throughput by 30% and reducing latency in transaction flows.
Centralized business rules using JBoss BRMS, reducing manual intervention and accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25%.
Participated in system design for .NET-based services, improving system resilience and reducing service downtime through fault-tolerant patterns.
Delivered .NET backend services powering digital credit and mobile wallet platforms used in production.
Eliminated operational bottlenecks by automating decision logic, improving processing efficiency and consistency.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, supporting business operations with improved data accessibility and performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Built Power BI dashboards that enabled stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions, reducing reporting turnaround time from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance systems built on .NET, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that streamlined administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
